name: email-spam-filter
description: Classify an inbound email as spam or ham with an LLM, then route it: ham is delivered, spam (or anything uncertain) is quarantined. Pass the email as process inputs.

steps.description: Fail-safe routing: only an explicit ham verdict is delivered; spam or any unexpected label is quarantined.
steps.run:
set -o pipefail; jq -r '
  (if (.classify.label) == "ham" then "DELIVER" else "QUARANTINE" end) as $action |
  "## Email verdict: " + $action + "\n" +
  "**From:** " + ((.sender // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Subject:** " + ((.subject // "(no subject)") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Label:** " + ((.classify.label // "(none)") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Confidence:** " + ((.classify.confidence // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Reason:** " + ((.classify.reason // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  (if $action == "DELIVER" then "Delivered to the inbox." else "Quarantined — not delivered (spam or uncertain)." end)
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{verdict: .}'
